title: Ceramics: Anagama and Wheel with Ben Owen III
how_to_join: Contact ddavid@hambidge.org to reserve a seat before registration opens
summary: Twelve-day intensive workshop with master ceramicist Ben Owen III, builder of the Hambidge anagama kiln. The workshop includes anagama firing experience alongside wheel throwing in a retreat setting with meals and optional on-campus lodging.
source_quote: July 21-Aug 1: Ceramics: Anagama and Wheel with Ben Owen III
evidence_quote: Ceramics: Anagama and Wheel with Ben Owen III
evidence_sentence: The 2027 workshop schedule lists a 12-day ceramics workshop with Ben Owen III that includes anagama and wheel instruction.
